name: application-pagination-cursor
title: Pagination Cursor
description: Prev/next cursor-based pager with a 'showing X–Y of total' range and a page-size selector, driven by a typed range/total/hasNext prop contract.
useWhen: Paging through results fetched via a cursor-based API where jumping to an arbitrary page number isn't possible.
Users benefit from seeing the current row range and total count alongside prev/next controls.
A data table or list needs an adjustable page size alongside cursor navigation.
avoidWhen: The backend supports offset-based paging and users need to jump to a specific page number — use the numbered Pagination component instead.
The dataset is small enough to show in full without paging.
Infinite scroll better fits the browsing pattern — a cursor pager adds unnecessary interaction steps.
responsiveBehavior: The range text, page-size selector, and prev/next controls sit on one row; the page-size label hides on narrow viewports while the select itself remains usable.
accessibility: Prev/next icon buttons carry visually hidden text ('Previous page', 'Next page') since they show only an icon.
Disabled prev/next buttons use the native disabled attribute so assistive tech announces they're unavailable, not just dimmed.
The page-size control is a real <select> wrapped in a <label> for full keyboard and screen-reader support.

variants.title: Pagination Cursor
variants.description: Cursor pager with a 'Showing X–Y of total' range, a rows-per-page select, and disabled-aware prev/next icon buttons.
accessibility: Icon-only prev/next buttons carry sr-only text so their purpose is announced without relying on the icon shape.

variants.title: Pagination Cursor (Dark)
variants.description: Cursor-based pager adapted for dark surfaces with the same range text, page-size select, and prev/next structure.
accessibility: Range text, select control, and button icons must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
